answer.reason: The "picture tiles" section is the Bento Section component (BentoSection), whose Bento Cards field is a nested grid of the BentoCard content list. Each tile is a BentoCard item with Eyebrow, Title, Description and a Graphic image field, which fits a large product screenshot. Alternatives were ruled out: GalleryImage (Gallery) is captioned pictures only, FeatureItem is icon-and-link, and carouselSlide is a rotating slide with a CTA. I did not save anything.
